correctness.rationale: Proof via de Bruijn graph vertex removal: exactly three excluded windows, imbalance of u and v precludes a one-use Euler tour; the only one-edge balancing augmentation duplicates e. Every ordinary binary de Bruijn cycle contracts its unique 0^(r+1) loop-and-passage into the added e, and every optimum has exactly two inverse expansions. A unique-multiplicity permitted window makes every optimum primitive, preventing rotational identification of the two preimages. Classical cycle count divided by two yields the formula. The embedded verifier enumerates r=2,3, exactly computes Laplacian tree determinants for r=2..6, and tests 225 constructions through r=10.
